inspect.title: Inspect & Edit CSS
inspect.description: Click any element to view its applied styles and attributes. Modify styles in the visual editor and see changes reflected on the page instantly.

record.title: Capture & Record
record.description: Take annotated screenshots or record up to 60 seconds of screen activity to capture the exact moment a bug happens.

log.title: Console & Network logs
log.description: Console errors, warnings, and network requests are captured automatically — so you never have to reproduce a bug just to grab the logs.

autoCollect.title: Auto-collect context
autoCollect.description: Browser, screen resolution, DOM details, console and network logs are gathered for you — with noise filtered out so the important signals stand out.

ai.title: AI bug reports
ai.description: Turn collected data into a structured report covering steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior.

send.title: One-click issue filing
send.description: Create and send tickets with full attachments to Jira, GitHub, Linear, or Notion — with a single click.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: Click the BugShot icon or open the side panel with a keyboard shortcut.

recordInspect.title: Record & inspect
recordInspect.description: Capture up to 60 seconds with logs, or select any element to edit styles live.

aiReport.title: AI report
aiReport.description: Get a structured draft with reproduction steps, expected and actual behavior — built from your captured data.

send.title: Send or export
send.description: Share via Markdown, your issue tracker, or any format your team prefers.

bottomCta.heading: All your Bugs, <brand>One Workflow</brand>.
subcopy: Link your platforms from the Integrations tab.
